dependency_snapshot.workspace_note: Hypermesh was deliberately left untouched. The implementation reuses Hypercurve's selected-root machinery and the exact univariate isolation/refinement supplied by Hypersolve.

semantic_evidence.authoritative_route: CurveRegion2::intersect_region continues through the single CurveRegionBooleanContext pair schedule. Algebraic chord/rational pairs enter BezierAlgebraicChord2::rational_intersections and its exact collinear specialization; no parallel Boolean or overlap engine was added.
semantic_evidence.structural_collinearity: The selected chord support determinant is replayed against the rational source coordinate polynomials. Only a structurally zero homogeneous determinant enters the positive-dimensional path; sampling never establishes collinearity.
semantic_evidence.injective_source: A derivative-sign proof reduces an injective collinear source to exact endpoint fibers, finite-chord clipping, and one oriented source/chord range correspondence.
semantic_evidence.noninjective_source: All selected chord-endpoint preimages, authored source-domain endpoints, and roots of the selected coordinate derivative numerator partition the source domain into exact monotone cells. One exact rational sample classifies each open cell, after which exact endpoint transport publishes every covered branch.
semantic_evidence.branch_multiplicity: Retraced source branches that cover the same geometric chord are retained as distinct overlap witnesses. Source ranges are oriented from the chord's low coordinate to its high coordinate; descending source ranges therefore carry Reversed orientation.
semantic_evidence.contact_and_overlap_coexistence: The pair result can carry isolated contacts and positive-length overlaps simultaneously. Boundary contacts not consumed by an overlap remain explicit, and exclusion of an authored adjacent parameter removes only that isolated contact, never a positive-length branch.
semantic_evidence.endpoint_identity: A one-bit selected-endpoint tag survives partition construction and clipping. Once exact support incidence and the chord's injective coordinate identify an endpoint, the engine does not attempt to rediscover that identity through an unrelated cross-field point comparison.
semantic_evidence.strict_policy: STRICT uses exact structural zero tests, exact endpoint fibers, Sturm-isolated derivative roots, certified parameter order, exact rational cell samples, and exact selected-root coordinate comparisons. Any unproved singular projection remains a typed blocker.
semantic_evidence.approximate_512_policy: APPROXIMATE_512 follows the same proof graph and observes all approximate certainty. Only the shared terminal may decide equality at 512 bits; published geometry and parameter ranges remain exact Hyperreal evidence.
semantic_evidence.lower_layer_correctness_fix: Selected algebraic coordinate comparison with a canonical Real first evaluates that Real in the selected root's defining polynomial and checks the isolator. This lets STRICT prove radical equality without invoking the approximate terminal.

benchmark_method.primary_metric: retired userspace instructions from seven taskset-pinned perf stat repetitions, with a matching disabled-lane process control subtracted
benchmark_method.secondary_metric: five taskset-pinned release wall samples after a discarded warm-up process
benchmark_method.fixture: A two-edge retained loop traverses the independently selected horizontal chord from sqrt(1/2) to sqrt(1/3) in both directions. A one-fragment closed quadratic x(t)=4t(1-t), y(t)=0 retraces the support. Public CurveRegion2 intersection schedules exactly two carrier pairs and returns four overlap witnesses, one Same and one Reversed source branch per chord traversal.
benchmark_method.fixture_scope_note: The deliberately retraced zero-area loops isolate intersection evidence rather than filled-region classification. A nondegenerate closure variant exposed the separately recorded noninjective isolated endpoint-contact blocker and was not allowed to contaminate this overlap benchmark.
